text: Jewels you can eat: what's really inside a passion fruit?
About half is shell. One fruit gives just eighteen grams of pulp and seeds.
Per hundred grams, that's ninety-seven calories, so one fruit has about seventeen.
The seeds are eaten too, and the pulp carries ten grams of fibre per hundred: four times an apple.
So one fruit adds about seventeen calories and two grams of fibre: log the pulp, not the shell.
